title: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
authority: Development Commissioner, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
currency_note: Official Gazette text hosted by the Development Commissioner (MSME). Read together with the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Act, 2026 and current classification notifications.

title: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Act, 2026
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
currency_note: Official Ministry upload published 2026-09-21. Verify the commencement provision and whether any commencement notification is required before promotion.

title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
currency_note: Official Ministry-hosted principal Act. Read together with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023, its corrigendum, and the Biological Diversity Rules, 2024.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
currency_note: Official NBA-hosted Gazette text. Read with the official commencement notification (effective 2024-04-01) and corrigendum in this batch.

title: Commencement Notification for the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
currency_note: Official NBA-hosted Gazette notification appointing 2024-04-01 as the commencement date of the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023.

title: Corrigendum to the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
currency_note: Official NBA-hosted corrigendum correcting the Gazette text of the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023.

title: The Biological Diversity Rules, 2024
currency_note: Official NBA-hosted rules notified 2024-10-22 and in force from 2024-12-21. They supersede the 2004 Rules and must be read with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025 in this batch.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
currency_note: Official Gazette text hosted by NBA, notified 2025-05-06 and in force from 2025-11-01.

title: The Biological Diversity (Access to Biological Resources and Knowledge Associated thereto and Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits) Regulations, 2025
currency_note: Official NBA notification dated 2025-04-29 and published 2025-04-30, effective on publication. It supersedes the 2014 access-and-benefit-sharing guidelines except for saved acts and omissions. Verify later amendments before promotion.

title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
currency_note: Official FSSAI-hosted Gazette text. Use as an authoritative parent-law source but verify subsequent amendments and current consolidated effect before promotion.
